sources.title: India-WRIS / National Water Data Portal, Groundwater Level Telemetry (6-hourly), Maharashtra GW - Pune district cut
sources.publisher: Maharashtra Groundwater Surveys and Development Agency, via India-WRIS / NWDP
sources.license: Government of India / Government of Maharashtra data portal, cited with attribution; published here only as derived aggregates, never as republished rows

conventions.depth_sign: The export is negative (depth below ground); this artifact publishes POSITIVE metres below ground level. A global rule is used here only because it was checked: 96.99% of readings are negative and no station of the 120 is predominantly positive, unlike Kolkata's mixed per-station convention.
conventions.aggregation: Monthly means of 6-hourly readings. The 6-hourly series is not republished.

_finding: 120 telemetric groundwater stations across Pune district, and only 1 inside the PMC/PCMC envelope. The rest instrument the eastern irrigation belt. This is why no per-ward urban depth surface is drawn for Pune: the density is real, and it is somewhere else.
